messages:
maria: tiny prototype up — need quick opinions. While model is streaming should primary action be 'Pause generation' (resumable) or 'Stop generation' (final)? Also where to surface token usage: inline under the streaming message or global header? figma: https://figma.com/proto/stream-ux :eyes: devin: +1 inline control next to the stream. 'Pause generation' is friendlier. If Pause is primary, add clear microcopy about what happens if you close the tab. Also add aria-pressed state for the toggle. sam: inline token counter under each message for context. Hide exact counts by default (show estimate like "~40") and reveal exact number on hover/focus for privacy. Tooltip: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)". elaine: a11y: use aria-live="polite" on the stream container and set aria-busy while streaming. Announce state changes with an offscreen status node (e.g., "Generation paused", "Generation resumed"). Keyboard focus should land on Resume after pausing. noah: UX edge-case: users may think Pause saves progress. Show a tiny paused badge: "Paused — resume to continue" with actions Resume / Stop and a short hint that closing the tab discards the session. For regenerate, overlay the message with "Regenerating..." + spinner instead of adding a new node. Debounce actions (300ms) to avoid double clicks. maria: proposal summary: primary = Pause (inline), Stop in overflow for hard cancel. Token counter inline, collapsed to estimate and expandable on hover/focus. I'll add two figma variants (Pause-primary vs Stop-primary) and run a 5-person internal quick test. devin: tiny aria snippet for prototype:
...chunks...
flip aria-busy to false when done and expose offscreen announcements. sam: tooltip copy locked: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + output)". Control tooltip: "Pause generation (Esc)" — include keyboard hint. Make token counter focusable (tabindex=0). elaine: keyboard map: Esc toggles Pause/Resume when focus within chat. '/' focuses composer. When paused, move focus to message actions. Ensure visible focus ring and accessible contrast. ux-bot: a11y quick-check: aria-live? yes. aria-busy? yes. offscreen announcements? pending. keyboard shortcuts documented? pending. tooltips tied to aria-describedby? yes. staging-bot: preview deployed: https://playground.staging.redwood/preview/stream-ux-185 (expires in 72h) maria: action items: @devin implement aria states + offscreen announcements; @sam add inline collapsed counter + tooltip; @elaine add keybindings + focus rules; @noah write paused badge copy. I'll post results of the quick test tomorrow. :thumbsup:
